subject: Compile-time arithmetic expressions
notes: kb/Work PB1369 re-verdict (w20261759a), cite.py --check 7.3.6.3 -> OK 7.3.6.3 2). GR2 lets the implementor define and document the mode: native, a standard mode or a mode unique to compile-time arithmetic. DOC-A.1-29 now documents the implemented mode per edition (System.Decimal, an implementor-unique mode, at 2023; standard arithmetic at 2002/2014, Annex E.2 6)) and the three defects the registrar found are gone: no 'standard mode for portability' claim, division is documented as ROUNDING (2/3*3 = 2 and 100/7*7 = 100, the documented values; probe on this build: C7=2 C11=100 C13=0 C14=-3 at 2023, and V3 = 2 selects in >>IF), the deleted EvalConstExpr and the closed directive-operand GAP are no longer named (also swept from CONFORMANCE.md section 3 and DESIGN-compile-time-expressions.md).
